description: Export a local workflow with marketplace metadata for sharing. Produces a JSON file with name, description, version, author, and tags suitable for submission to the marketplace registry.

author.description: Author name to include in metadata

version.description: Version string (semver-style, e.g., '1.2.3'). Defaults to '1.0.0' if omitted. Increment when publishing an updated workflow so registry consumers can detect changes.

workflow.description: Name of the local workflow to export (from adb_workflow_list)

name: adb_market_export
